purpose: Audit whether the already source-locked RTK/U(1) action and symmetry stack contains an additional field, compensator, or spurion with an independently specified constant-homogeneous spatial-conformal transformation law that could evade the s6fO/s6fP operator-weight obstruction without inventing a new nonlinear completion.
frozen_questions: Is the Newtonian prepotential nu assigned an independent homogeneous spatial-conformal/Weyl weight in the source-locked stack?
Is the U(1) gauge field A assigned such a weight?
Is the RTK scalar Sigma assigned such a weight, rather than being U(1)-neutral?
Is there an explicit Weyl/anisotropic-Weyl symmetry or compensator rule already frozen in the cited action stack?
Can any existing U(1) transformation be reinterpreted as the required homogeneous spatial-conformal compensator without adding a new transformation law?

frozen_decision_rule.FOUND_SOURCE_LOCKED_COMPENSATOR: Only if an explicit independent homogeneous spatial-conformal transformation law is present in the cited source-lock and can change the soft weight without redefining the frozen symmetry.
frozen_decision_rule.NO_SOURCE_LOCKED_COMPENSATOR: If fields/gauge variables exist but only U(1)/Diff transformation laws are source-locked and no spatial-conformal compensator/spurion law is specified.

forbidden: assigning a new Weyl weight to nu, A, Sigma, N, or another field
choosing a compensator coupling to cancel the existing soft vertex
claiming absence from this audit is a no-go for all enlarged UV completions
nonclaims: not a no-go for an enlarged extra-field UV completion
does not unblock k=0.03 Mpc^-1 production
